facts.text: Source titles disagree on the Benavides v. Tesla award: one gives $242 million and another gives $243 million, but both figures are roundings of the same total.
facts.quote: One source title gives $242 million and another $243 million.

facts.text: The Benavides v. Tesla award combined $200 million in punitive damages with Tesla's one-third share of the compensatory damages.
facts.quote: The award combined $200 million in punitive damages with Tesla's one-third share of the compensatory damages
